blocks.text: Anasir ko us subshell se baanta ja sakta hai jis mein un ke valence electrons hain. Pehle do groups ke anasir ke valence electrons s subshells mein hain, to yeh anasir s block banate hain. Transition elements d block se taalluq rakhte hain, aur table ke neeche ki do qatarein, lanthanides aur actinides, f block hain. Baqi anasir, groups 13 se 18 aakhri group ki inert gases samet, p block se taalluq rakhte hain.

Kisi unsur ka block janna us ki khusoosiyat ke bare mein qeemti maloomat deta hai: kimiyai reactivity, oxidation states aur electronegativity, ionization energy aur electron bharne jaisi doosri khusoosiyat.

blocks.prompt: Unsur X group 2 mein aur unsur Y group 15 mein hai. Har ek ka block aur woh subshell batayein jis mein us ke valence electrons hain.
blocks.explanation: X s block mein hai, valence electrons s subshell mein; Y p block mein hai, valence electrons p subshell mein.

items: s block: groups 1 aur 2; p block: groups 13 se 18; d block: transition elements; f block: lanthanides aur actinides.
Block reactivity, oxidation states, electronegativity, ionization energy aur electron bharne ke bare mein batata hai.
